components.name: Theme Control
components.description: Persistent Dark/Light choice, first control in the sidebar footer.
components.html: Theme
components.css: .ds-theme-control { min-width: 0; margin: 0 0 9px; padding: 0; border: 0; color: #e9eae5; font: .875rem "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-theme-control legend { padding: 0; margin-bottom: 4px; line-height: 1.35; color: #929a9a; font-size: .75rem; } .ds-theme-options { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 3px; padding: 3px; border: 1px solid #2a2e30; border-radius: 7px; background: #101214; } .ds-theme-options button { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; min-height: 36px; margin: 0; padding: 6px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; color: #929a9a; background: transparent; font: inherit; font-size: .8125rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-theme-options button:hover { color: #e9eae5; background: #1d2123; } .ds-theme-options button[aria-pressed="true"] { color: #c7ee79; background: #c7ee7910; } .ds-theme-options button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c7ee79; outline-offset: 0; }

components.name: Sidebar Select Row
components.description: Text size and Reading width consistently stack an unwrapped label above a full-width selector at every viewport.
components.css: .ds-sidebar-select { display: grid; gap: 4px; margin-bottom: 8px; color: #929a9a; font: .875rem "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-sidebar-select > span { line-height: 1.35; font-size: .75rem; } .ds-sidebar-select select { width: 100%; min-width: 0; padding: 6px 9px; border: 1px solid #2a2e30; border-radius: 7px; background: #111416; color: #e9eae5; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-sidebar-select select:hover { border-color: #3d4543; } .ds-sidebar-select select:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c7ee79; outline-offset: 0; }

components.name: Anchored Filter Menu
components.description: Popover positioned from its trigger's rectangle and clamped to the viewport; becomes a bottom sheet at 680px and below.
components.html: Refine your recordings
components.css: .ds-filter-menu { width: min(300px, calc(100vw - 32px)); max-height: 65vh; overflow-y: auto; overscroll-behavior: contain; padding: 20px; background: #1b1f21; border: 1px solid #3d4543; border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 15px 55px #0008; color: #e9eae5; font: .875rem "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-filter-menu-heading { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 17px; } .ds-filter-menu h3 { margin: 0; font-size: .8125rem; font-weight: 550; } .ds-filter-menu-close { display: none; min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; margin-right: -6px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: none; color: #929a9a; cursor: pointer; } .ds-filter-menu-close:hover { color: #e9eae5; background: #ffffff09; } .ds-filter-menu label { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; margin-bottom: 12px; font-size: .75rem; color: #aeb5b1; } .ds-filter-menu select { width: 100%; padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #2a2e30; border-radius: 7px; background: #111416; color: #e9eae5; font-size: .875rem; } .ds-filter-menu select:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c7ee79; outline-offset: 0; } @media (max-width: 680px) { .ds-filter-menu { width: 100%; max-height: 80dvh; padding: 16px 18px calc(20px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); border-width: 1px 0 0; border-radius: 14px 14px 0 0; box-shadow: 0 -12px 45px #0009; } .ds-filter-menu-close { display: inline-flex; } }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Filled action for creating a workspace group; resume-command copying uses the quieter secondary style.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 9px; min-height: 37px; padding: 9px 13px; border: 1px solid #c7ee79; border-radius: 6px; background: #c7ee79; color: #1b2413; font: 550 .875rem "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s, transform .15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #d7f5a0; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c7ee79; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: .42; cursor: not-allowed; transform: none; }

components.name: Search Box

components.css: .ds-search-box { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; height: 46px; padding: 0 13px; background: #1a1e20; border: 1px solid #363d3e; border-radius: 8px; color: #9ca4a4; font: .875rem "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-search-box:focus-within { border-color: #a7c16d; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #c7ee7908; } .ds-search-box input { flex: 1; width: 0; padding: 11px 0; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #e9eae5; font: inherit; outline: none; } .ds-search-box input::placeholder { color: #828a8c; } .ds-search-box kbd { font: .75rem "Cascadia Code", Consolas, monospace; color: #929a9a; border: 1px solid #2a2e30; border-radius: 4px; padding: 2px 5px; }

components.name: Filter Tab
components.description: Quick filter above the recordings list; active state fills with a muted olive-charcoal.
components.css: .ds-filter-tabs { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 6px; } .ds-filter-tab { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 30px; padding: 5px 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: none; color: #9ca4a5; font: .875rem "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-filter-tab:hover { color: #e9eae5; background: #ffffff05; } .ds-filter-tab.ds-active { color: #d5dacd; background: #242a25; border-color: #3b4435; } .ds-filter-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c7ee79; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Session Row

components.css: .ds-session-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 37px minmax(0, 1fr) max-content; align-items: center; gap: 14px; width: 100%; padding: 19px 9px 19px 0; text-align: left; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #252a2c; border-radius: 4px; background: none; color: #e9eae5; font-family: "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background .14s, box-shadow .14s; } .ds-session-row:hover { background: #ffffff03; } .ds-session-row.ds-selected { background: #c7ee7908; box-shadow: inset 2px 0 #c7ee79; } .ds-session-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c7ee79; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-session-symbol { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 35px; height: 37px; color: #aab3a4; border: 1px solid #343d35; background: #c7ee7906; border-radius: 8px; } .ds-session-main { display: block; min-width: 0; } .ds-session-title { display: block; font-size: .875rem; font-weight: 530; line-height: 1.6; color: #d9ddd5; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-session-path { display: block; margin-top: 7px; font: .75rem "Cascadia Code", Consolas, monospace; color: #99a298; } .ds-session-time { font: .75rem "Cascadia Code", Consolas, monospace; color: #9ba59d; white-space: nowrap; }

narrative.overview:
claude-blackbox is a dense, practical recorder UI: structured panes, quiet dividers, compact controls, and a single unmistakable dark accent make long session histories legible without turning the workspace into a dashboard spectacle. The default dark appearance is the incumbent system and remains unchanged.

The approved light mode is a durable alternate palette, not a redesign. It retains the same type, spacing, icon strokes, hierarchy, and responsive behavior while replacing the charcoal surfaces with muted off-white and gray; semantic green and red remain reserved for meaningful status and diff states.

Reading comfort is a settings concern rather than a layout concern. Theme, Text size, and Reading width sit together in one compact sidebar footer, each persists explicitly, and none of them moves a pane or alters the type ramp.
keyCharacteristics: Charcoal-and-lime default with an explicit grayscale light alternate.
System sans for UI, monospace for paths and code.
Three persisted reading preferences with consistently stacked labels in one sidebar footer.

rules.name: The Preserved Dark Rule
rules.body: Dark mode is the baseline visual system; alternate-theme work must not alter its tokens or appearance.

rules.name: The Restrained Light Rule
rules.body: In light mode, ordinary navigation and controls stay grayscale; green and red communicate semantic status rather than decoration.

rules.name: The Shared Scale Rule
rules.body: Theme choice changes color only; it never changes the established type ramp, the larger-text preference, or the reading-width measure.

rules.name: The Legible Floor Rule
rules.body: No interface text is set below 11px. When a label must take less room, reduce its tracking and padding rather than its size.

rules.name: The Stable Frame Rule
rules.body: Theme changes recolor existing surfaces; they do not move navigation, library, replay, or top-bar structure.

rules.name: The In-Viewport Menu Rule
rules.body: A popover is anchored to its trigger but constrained by the viewport: 16px edge inset, 120px height floor, and a bottom sheet on phones. No menu may be positioned where it can open off-screen.

rules.name: The Single Dismissal Rule
rules.body: Every transient surface, including the filter menu, the session-details menu, the shortcuts popover, the mobile drawer, and the grouping dialog, closes on Escape and on an outside pointer-down, and returns focus to the control that opened it.

dos: Do preserve the dark token set when extending light mode or theme controls.
Do use the grayscale light stack for standard light surfaces, borders, and selection.
Do keep Theme, Text size, and Reading width together in the sidebar footer and retain them in the mobile drawer.
Do apply saved explicit preferences before application rendering and update browser chrome to match.
Do anchor popovers from their trigger's rectangle against the viewport, with a 16px edge inset and a 120px height floor, and use the bottom sheet below 681px.
Do give every overlay the shared Escape and outside-dismissal behavior with focus return.
Do keep interface text at or above 11px, trading tracking and padding for space instead of size.
Do state an absent value plainly ("Model not recorded", an em dash for an unknown total), and carry the unit for assistive technology beside a bare number.
donts: Don't infer theme from system appearance; default to dark until the user explicitly selects Light.
Don't use lime as general light-mode decoration or replace meaningful success/error colors with neutral styling.
Don't change typography, spacing, or responsive structure merely to support a palette switch.
Don't pin an overlay to its container's edge with ordinary absolute positioning; a menu that can open outside the viewport is a defect.
Don't constrain the measure of code, diffs, tables, or tool cards; the reading-width setting applies to prose blocks only.
